name: Bard
gmNotes: Bard is a profession archetype. It is distinct from the Bard Origin — a player-character mechanical package (an attribute and three trained abilities). An NPC who makes music for a living may carry the Bard archetype without the Origin. Origins are expected for playable protagonists only. The archetype grants no mechanics.
description: A poet, musician, and keeper of stories who travels between villages, trading in songs, news, and reputations. Bards are welcome in every hall and trusted in none entirely, and they remember everything they hear.
